description: StEER - Hurricane Dorian: Field Assessment Structural Team (FAST-1) Early Access Reconnaissance Report (EARR) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This Early Access Reconnaissance Report (EARR) is StEER’s second product from this event and provides an overview of Hurricane Dorian, StEER’s event response, and preliminary findings based on the data and observations generated by its first Field Assessment Structural Team (FAST-1). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-4616-1e25. Keywords: StEER, Reconnaissance, EARR, hurricane, Marsh Harbour, Treasure Cay. Published 2019-10-13. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
